content.title: Where to watch Arizona vs. Purdue Elite Eight matchup for free tonight
content.text: Updated: Mar. 28, 2026, 6:00 p.m.Published: Mar. 28, 2026, 6:00 p.m.Arizona forward Koa Peat (10) walks off the court after a win over Arkansas in the Sweet 16 of the NCAA college basketball tournament, Thursday, March 26, 2026, in San Jose, Calif.AP Photo/Kelley L CoxIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Jenna Malinowski | JMalinowski@mlive.comThe No. 1 Arizona Wildcats and the No. 2 Purdue Boilermakers will face off tonight for a spot in the Final Four.Fans can catch the Elite Eight action from San Jose on TBS/TruTV at 8:49 p.m. ET, with streaming options available through DirecTV Stream, Sling and HBO Max.Elite Eight Streaming OptionsTable not scrollableDirecTV Stream: DirecTV Stream’s Choice plan includes access to TBS and TruTV among many others. Fans can start with a five-day free trial and take $35 off the first month of their subscription.Sling: TBS is one of 55 channels available with Sling’s Orange and Blue plan for $64.99 per month. New subscribers can take half off the first month of their subscription with this plan, bringing the cost down to just $32.50.HBO Max: Fans can catch live sports, including March Madness games, MLB on TBS and NHL on TNT, with HBO Max’s standard plan.
